title: Just sort it! A note on the LP behind rank-one anti-loop edits
abstract: arXiv:2611.21432v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Weight-space programming removes the thinking loops of a small reasoning model by a rank-one edit W' = W + u v^T of an MLP output matrix, where u is a loop direction and v is the solution of a sparse Linear Program (LP) over the neuron activations. We investigate whether the LP is needed. We replace it by a sort: we take the 8 neurons whose activation has the smallest coefficient of variation, and give them equal shares of the push that the LP solution realizes. On Qwen3.5-0.8B the sorted edit scores 67.0% on 1000 problems (MATH-500 and GSM8K) against 67.4% for the LP edit and 9.5% for the unedited model; the paired difference is -0.4 points, with 95% confidence interval [-2.9, +2.1], inside a non-inferiority margin of 5 points declared before the runs. On three further sampling seeds the difference is -0.6 points, interval [-2.0, +0.8], and -0.8 points, interval [-2.3, +0.6], when the dose is set without the LP. The sort does not solv

translated_title: 直接排序就行！关于秩一反循环编辑背后的线性规划的注释
translated_abstract: 权重空间编程通过对MLP输出矩阵进行秩一编辑 W' = W + uv^T 来消除小型推理模型的思考循环，其中u是循环方向，v是基于神经元激活的稀疏线性规划（LP）的解。我们研究是否真的需要这个LP。我们用排序来替代它：选取激活变异系数最小的8个神经元，并将LP解所实现的推力均分给它们。在Qwen3.5-0.8B上，排序编辑在1000道题目（MATH-500和GSM8K）上得分为67.0%，而LP编辑为67.4%，未编辑模型为9.5%；配对差异为-0.4分，95%置信区间为[-2.9, +2.1]，在实验前预先设定的5分非劣效性界限之内。在另外三个采样种子上，当不使用LP来设定剂量时，差异分别为-0.6分（区间[-2.0, +0.8]）和-0.8分（区间[-2.3, +0.6]）。排序并不能解决……
tldr: 本文发现一个简单的排序方法——选取激活变异系数最小的8个神经元均分推力——可以替代稀疏线性规划来实现秩一反循环编辑，且性能不劣于LP方法。
en_tdlr: A simple sort-based heuristic—equally distributing the push among the 8 neurons with the smallest coefficient of variation—matches the performance of a sparse linear program for rank-one anti-loop edits, showing that the LP is unnecessary.
